* **10+ years of experience** in End User Computing, Modern Workplace, Endpoint Management, or related technology services.
* **5+ years of experience** working with Microsoft Intune, SCCM and enterprise endpoint management technologies.

title: Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations
description:
**Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations**

**Location:** Bengaluru, India  
**Reporting to:** Global Head of Talent Acquisition

  

**About the Role**

LSEG is seeking a Talent Acquisition leader to lead global hiring for our Operations organisation.

Leading a global team of approximately 20 Talent Acquisition professionals and supporting around 2,000 hires annually, this role oversees one of LSEG’s largest and most operationally complex talent portfolios.

The current portfolio combines significant scale with a strong internal mobility agenda. Approximately 50% of hiring is internal and 50% external, with the majority of activity taking place at Associate or Senior Associate level.

The portfolio is concentrated in major global delivery locations with c55% of volume in India, c25% in the Philippines, and c10% in Poland.

Partnering closely with Operations, People and business leaders, the Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations will deliver outcomes across three strategic priorities: Quality, Speed and Insight. Beyond recruitment delivery, the role acts as a strategic advisor, using talent intelligence, workforce insight and labour-market expertise to influence hiring, skills, location and resourcing decisions.

The portfolio will continue to evolve as technology, automation and AI reshape work and skills requirements. The successful candidate will help Operations anticipate this shift, balancing current delivery at scale with increasing demand for more specialised, analytical, transformation-oriented and senior talent. The role will also maximise opportunities for internal talent movement and career progression.

The successful candidate will be a key member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, contributing to enterprise-wide Talent Acquisition strategy, transformation priorities and the continued evolution of LSEG’s hiring capabilities.

**Scope**

* Global responsibility for Operations Talent Acquisition.
* Leadership of c20 Talent Acquisition professionals across multiple locations.
* Delivery of approximately 2,000 hires annually.
* Accountability for hiring across operational, change, transformation, controls, specialist and leadership disciplines up to Director level.
* Member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, helping shape enterprise Talent Acquisition strategy and priorities.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Strategic Talent Partner
* Develop and implement Talent Acquisition strategies aligned to Operations workforce requirements, location strategy and business priorities.
* Partner with Operations and People leaders to shape workforce plans, anticipate how skills and role requirements will evolve, and address emerging capability gaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor, providing market insight, talent intelligence and data-driven recommendations that improve workforce, location and hiring decisions.
* Help leaders balance external recruitment, internal mobility, capability building and workforce redeployment as the composition of demand changes.
* Hiring Delivery and Performance
* Own end-to-end hiring outcomes for the Operations portfolio, balancing quality, speed, candidate experience and cost.
* Create clear portfolio priorities, service expectations and performance rhythms that translate demand into executable hiring plans.
* Use data to identify demand, capacity, conversion, ageing and location risks, intervening early to improve outcomes.
* Differentiate hiring approaches by segment, combining scalable delivery for recurring demand with specialist-led and advisory models for more complex and senior roles.
* Accelerate internal mobility by improving visibility of opportunities and enabling effective movement of talent across the organisation.

**Leadership and Capability**

* Lead, develop and hold accountable a globally distributed Talent Acquisition team, creating clarity of purpose, priorities and performance expectations.
* Evolve the team’s capability as the portfolio shifts from predominantly high-volume hiring towards more complex, specialist and senior requirements.
* Build an impactful, inclusive team with strong business knowledge, market expertise, commercial judgement and advisory capability.
* Ensure the team deploys capacity flexibly against business priorities and operates effectively across locations and time zones.

**Transformation and Enterprise Contribution**

* Champion consistent, technology-enabled and insight-led hiring practices across the portfolio.
* Use automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve scalability, quality and speed, with appropriate human oversight and governance.
* Help reshape the Talent Acquisition service as workforce demand evolves, ensuring recruiter capacity is increasingly focused on higher-value, complex and advisory work.
* Contribute to enterprise Talent Acquisition priorities and partner across Talent Acquisition, People Services and People Engineering to establish clear accountabilities and effective end-to-end delivery.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Significant Talent Acquisition leadership experience supporting operations, service delivery, business services or similarly complex distributed organisations.
* Proven track record of leading hiring at scale across a broad range of operational and leadership talent, with the judgement to differentiate volume, specialist and senior hiring approaches.
* Strong business partnering and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge, advise and build credibility with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to translate workforce and hiring strategies into measurable business outcomes.
* Experience evolving Talent Acquisition capability and capacity as business demand, skills requirements and service models change.
* Proven experience improving hiring performance through demand management, process discipline, data, technology and clear accountability.
* Experience using talent intelligence and analytics to improve hiring, workforce planning, internal mobility and location decisions.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and change while maintaining delivery focus and team engagement.

**Preferred**

* Experience within financial services, financial markets infrastructure, technology-enabled services, shared services or another highly regulated global environment.
* Experience leading, developing and being accountable for the performance and outcomes of geographically distributed Talent Acquisition teams.
* Experience leading Talent Acquisition across multiple geographies and major operational hubs, particularly India, the Philippines and Poland.
* Responsibility for a talent portfolio of significant scale and complexity, spanning volume, specialist, change and leadership hiring.
* Experience supporting Operations organisations through transformation, organisational redesign, location strategy or operating model change.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled, technology-driven or automation-led Talent Acquisition solutions with appropriate governance and human oversight.
* Experience building internal mobility and talent redeployment into the hiring model.
* Experience working as part of a senior Talent Acquisition or People leadership team, contributing to broader enterprise priorities.

**Why Join LSEG?**

This is an opportunity to lead a significant global Talent Acquisition portfolio at the centre of how LSEG serves customers, manages risk and delivers operational performance.

The immediate challenge is substantial: a team of approximately 20 supporting around 2,000 hires annually across a globally distributed portfolio, with internal mobility accounting for approximately half of hiring. The broader opportunity is to help shape how the portfolio evolves as technology changes work, skills requirements become more complex and a greater share of Talent Acquisition capacity moves towards specialist and advisory activity.

The role offers exposure to senior Operations, People and enterprise leaders globally, and the opportunity to influence workforce composition, location, capability and career mobility across one of LSEG’s largest employee populations.

As a member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, the successful candidate will help shape the future direction of Talent Acquisition across LSEG while partnering directly with Operations leaders on important workforce and transformation priorities.

We are interested in established Talent Acquisition leaders as well as high-potential individuals ready to step into a broader global leadership role. The critical requirement is a track record of leading complex hiring portfolios, developing high-performing teams and influencing business outcomes through talent expertise, insight and execution.

  
  

**ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

**Career Stage:**

Director

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.

In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.
* Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.
* Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.
* Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
* Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
* Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
* Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
* Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.
* A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.
* Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.
* The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.
* Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.
* Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.
Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.

We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. description:
You will work as part of international, multidisciplinary teams providing robust, impartial and influential advice across the policy lifecycle, from policy development and appraisal through implementation, monitoring, evaluation and review. The role combines economic analysis, quantitative modelling, research and clear communication to help public- and private-sector clients understand the economic, environmental and social implications of policy and investment decisions.

Depending on your experience, you may lead defined workstreams, manage tasks or smaller projects, support and review the work of colleagues, contribute to proposals and help strengthen WSP’s global Policy & Economics offering

  

• Undertake economic appraisal and policy analysis, including cost-benefit analysis, cost-effectiveness analysis, socio-economic analysis, regulatory impact assessment, feasibility assessment and evaluation.

• Develop quantitative evidence through data collection, validation and analysis; econometric or statistical analysis; scenario and sensitivity analysis; market assessment; and economic or financial modelling.

• Assess the distributional, competitiveness, fiscal, social and environmental implications of policies, programmes, regulations and investments.

• Support climate-policy and decarbonisation assignments, which may include carbon pricing, emissions trading, carbon leakage, transition pathways, investment economics and the cost-effectiveness of policy measures.

• Contribute to ex-ante appraisal and ex-post evaluation, including the development of theories of change, evaluation frameworks, indicators and evidence-based recommendations.

• Plan and deliver primary and secondary research, stakeholder engagement, surveys, interviews and consultations, where relevant.

• Prepare clear, concise and defensible reports, policy briefs, presentations, models and other client deliverables in English.

• Work collaboratively with specialists across environmental science, engineering, climate, natural capital, infrastructure, finance and other disciplines on global projects.

• Contribute to project management, quality assurance, commercial delivery and adherence to agreed scope, budget and programme.

• Support proposals, capability development and knowledge sharing; take a active role in client relationships, opportunity development and technical leadership.

**Sector and thematic experience**

Experience across multiple sectors or policy areas would be useful. We do not expect candidates to cover every area; applications are welcomed from economists who bring strong depth in one or more fields and an ability to apply their economics skills across unfamiliar topics.

• Climate change, net zero and decarbonisation, including carbon pricing and climate-policy instruments

• Energy, power, industry and industrial decarbonisation

• Transport, infrastructure, cities and the built environment

• Water, wastewater and wider environmental regulation

• Waste, resources, circular economy and sustainable consumption

• Air quality, industrial emissions, chemicals, health and safety policy

• Natural capital, biodiversity, ecosystem services and nature-related policy

• Sustainable finance, green investment, taxonomy and transition-related analysis

• Economic development, competitiveness, trade, innovation, labour markets or public policy

**Technical skills and experience**

• Strong grounding in microeconomics, public economics, environmental economics, applied economics or a closely related field.

• Demonstrable experience applying economic techniques to policy, regulatory, environmental, infrastructure or sustainability questions.

• Highly numerate, with the ability to structure complex analytical problems and translate findings into practical advice.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including structured models, scenario and sensitivity analysis, data tables, pivot tables, charts and advanced formulae.

• Experience with one or more analytical tools such as Python, R or Stata for data cleaning, statistical analysis, econometrics, modelling or visualisation would be advantageous.

• Experience in macroeconomic, input-output or Computable General Equilibrium modelling would be advantageous but is not essential for all candidates.

• Familiarity with credible national and international sources of government, industry and economic statistics.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, precise and well-evidenced outputs in English.

  

• A graduate/postgraduate qualification in economics, econometrics, environmental economics, development economics, public policy or another closely related quantitative discipline is preferred.

description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

AHEAD is seeking a senior, customer-facing Technical Consultant to lead delivery of Idira Privilege Cloud (formerly CyberArk Privilege Cloud) implementations. You will own technical workstreams from discovery and design through configuration, integration, testing, and handoff. You will advise customer security, identity, and infrastructure teams, resolve complex implementation issues, and help raise the technical quality of the broader delivery team.

Idira Privilege Cloud is a SaaS privileged-access solution for safeguarding credentials, automating password rotation, and monitoring privileged sessions.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical discovery and translate customer requirements into implementable Privilege Cloud designs, deployment plans, and delivery estimates.
* Own one or more technical workstreams through implementation, integration, testing, issue resolution, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Design and configure core PAM capabilities, including safes, accounts, platforms, access controls, password rotation and reconciliation policies, and privileged-session workflows.
* Lead deployment and troubleshooting of Privilege Cloud connectors and related components, including CPM, PSM, and SSH-based access, in coordination with customer infrastructure teams.
* Plan and oversee onboarding of privileged accounts across Windows, Linux/Unix, directory services, databases, network devices, and business applications.
* Lead integrations with customer identity providers and directory services, including authentication, user and group mapping, and access-model troubleshooting.
* Diagnose complex issues spanning the Idira platform and customer infrastructure; coordinate with vendor or customer teams, communicate impact and options, and drive issues to resolution.
* Review implementation decisions and deliverables for security, operability, and alignment with customer requirements and established practices.
* Serve as a trusted technical contact for customer stakeholders; communicate risks, assumptions, dependencies, and recommendations clearly.
* Coach and support other consultants through design reviews, troubleshooting, knowledge sharing, and practical delivery guidance.
* Contribute technical input to scoping, solution proposals, project plans, and knowledge assets; collaborate with AHEAD architects, project managers, and delivery colleagues across regions.
* Support project travel and reasonable time-zone overlap when required for customer delivery.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, systems engineering, cybersecurity, identity, or privileged access management, including substantial customer-facing delivery.
* 3+ years of hands-on implementation or administration experience with Idira/CyberArk Privilege Cloud or CyberArk PAM.
* Demonstrated ownership of PAM implementation workstreams, including privileged account onboarding, access policies, credential rotation and reconciliation, and/or session management.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, make and explain implementation decisions, and manage delivery dependencies with limited day-to-day oversight.
* Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux/Unix administration, networking fundamentals, DNS, firewalls, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience diagnosing complex integrations across enterprise infrastructure and producing clear technical designs, runbooks, test plans, and handoff documentation.
* Strong customer communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineering and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor peers, lead technical reviews, and collaborate effectively with distributed delivery teams.

### **Certification:**

Applicants must hold at least one current, relevant Idira/CyberArk Privilege Cloud credential or delivery certification. Preferred credentials include:

* **CDE-CPC** — CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer, Privilege Cloud.
* **CPC-SEN** — Sentry – Privilege Cloud.
* Another current, vendor-recognized **CPC or CDE** credential relevant to Privilege Cloud/PAM may be considered.

Candidates with a related CyberArk PAM CDE credential and demonstrable senior-level Privilege Cloud delivery experience may also be considered. Certification names and availability can change; validate the credential title against the current Idira/CyberArk University certification catalog before publishing the posting.

### **Nice to Have Skills:**

* Active Directory: domains, users and groups, service accounts, Group Policy, and domain-joined systems.
* LDAP concepts and directory integrations.
* Advanced Windows Server and Linux/Unix troubleshooting, scripting, and service management.
* Database fundamentals, including accounts, permissions, connectivity, and credential rotation for common relational databases.
* Scripting or automation with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or REST APIs.
* Experience with SIEM integration, audit requirements, secrets management, or enterprise security controls.
* Familiarity with cloud and hybrid environments, virtualization, and network/security appliances.
* Experience contributing to solution scoping, effort estimates, architecture diagrams, and customer-facing proposals.

### **What success looks like:**

* Technical workstreams are delivered with clear ownership, sound implementation decisions, and predictable communication of risks and dependencies.
* Customer environments meet agreed requirements and are documented for secure, sustainable operations.
* Privileged accounts and systems are onboarded with appropriate access, rotation, and session controls.
* Complex technical issues are resolved efficiently, with appropriate customer and vendor coordination.
* Customer administrators can confidently operate the delivered solution after handoff, and less-experienced consultants benefit from the senior consultant’s technical guidance.

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

Indirect Tax has 9 sub-functions which manage Global accounts. Indirect Tax is spread across 8 GDS Locations. Our footprint extends to over 30+ countries in the world and looking at expanding it to over 50+ countries soon. We help country practices streamline and manage large engagements for several clients. Our team is Dynamic, culturally diverse and inclusive global workforce. Organized across geographic areas and business lines We drive high performance work culture.

**The opportunity**

  

As a Manager for the EMEIA Tax Center, you will actively work on the finalized deliverables on projects/services in the domain of Indirect Tax / VAT

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Being a central point of contact – liaise with your international clients and colleagues with respect to European VAT and VAT compliance.
* Fully comprehend the scope of each client engagement to identify what is out of scope and thus a "win" or additional work.
* Capture all out of scope work to your clients and record on Pipeline spreadsheet or direct it to the Process Owner to do so
* Organizing and coordinating the client serving team during the resolution of any out of scope activities.
* Monitoring the quality of the indirect tax data and reports of your clients.
* Final review and sign-off of indirect tax returns.
* Follow up on legislative changes and business changes in order to ensure that the systems and/or processes are updated.
* Act as point of contact for the process owner ('Senior Manager') and client.
* Assist the Assistance VAT Controller ('Assistance manager') in case of issues encountered during the preparation of the returns.
* Proposing improvement possibilities to raise the effectiveness and efficiency of the work processes.
* Organizing the annual desktop review.
* Final review of the periodical indirect tax compliance calendar and sending this to the client.
* Act as point of contact for local EY offices/SMO-teams and other EY parties involved in a project.
* Managing the completion of the full cycle for an indirect tax return.
* Managing the set-up of new technology tools.
* Updating the engagement documentation (desk procedures).
* Managing contractual agreement with local EY offices.
* Identify opportunities to bring to clients based upon their footprint and issues.
* Broaden your own internal networks within the sub service line, but also across sub service lines.
* Assist with RFP activity with Process Owners and Partners.
* Broaden the relationship network with existing clients and participate in commercial initiatives together with senior executives or partners.
* Staying up to date on all relevant changes in the international tax landscape and actively transfer this knowledge in order to support the continuous development of your colleagues.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Is always open to different perspectives and takes the time to actively listen and encourage ongoing dialogue between all members of the team.
* Communicates proactively and often with counselors and team members to drive open and honest development and career conversations for the purpose of building trust, authentic meaningful relationships and exceptional career experiences.
* Actively uses their network to further advance their team members and counselors
* Drives the retention and recruitment of a high performing, diverse, team.
* Promotes flexibility and enables our people to achieve both their personal and professional goals.
* Provides ongoing, quality direction to team members and/or counselors in order to help them maximize their performance and achieve their potential.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

* At least 6 years of relevant professional experience in European VAT and VAT compliance required.
* Fluent in English – written and spoken.
* Team player with project management skills and focusing on organizing a team to work in the most efficient way.

description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization covering Cloud & Network Security, Detection Engineering (SOC), and Identity & Access Management (IAM). We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0, run a continuous red-team and penetration-testing program with external partners, and work directly with customers on security architecture reviews and briefings. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a Senior Manager to own and lead three connected disciplines: **Cloud Security, IAM, and the Security Operations Center (Detection & Response)**. You will manage and grow engineers and leads across these areas, set technical direction, and be the accountable owner for how Harness secures its cloud infrastructure, controls access to it, and detects and responds to threats against it.

This is a player-coach role. You are expected to go deep technically, make architecture calls, and also build the team, the operating cadence, and the metrics that show security maturity improving quarter over quarter.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Cloud Security**

* Own the security architecture and posture of Harness's multi-cloud and Kubernetes-based production environments, including network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and hardened baselines.
* Drive secure-by-default infrastructure through policy-as-code (e.g., OPA), guardrails in CI/CD, and continuous posture management.
* Partner with Platform and SRE on dedicated-tenant and customer-hosted deployment models, including the controls that make those models safe at enterprise scale.
* Support the security of customer-facing runtime components such as the Harness Delegate, including token scoping, least-privilege execution, and containment of compromised components.

### **Identity & Access Management**

* Own the workforce and workload identity strategy: SSO, MFA, privileged access, just-in-time access, service-account and machine-identity lifecycle, and access reviews.
* Advance Zero Trust principles across internal systems and production, using a central authority model with human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions.
* Reduce standing privilege and credential sprawl; make least privilege measurable and auditable.

### **Security Operations & Detection Engineering**

* Lead the SOC and Detection Engineering function: detection coverage, alert quality, triage, incident response, and on-call readiness.
* Build detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and validate them through purple-team exercises and red-team findings.
* Own the incident response lifecycle, from runbooks and tabletop exercises to post-incident reviews that feed back into engineering and control improvements.
* Improve automation and tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud-native logging) to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

### **Leadership & Program Management**

* Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team; set clear expectations, growth paths, and a healthy on-call culture.
* Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and executive-ready reporting.
* Work with external red-team and penetration-testing partners to scope exercises, triage findings, and drive remediation to closure.
* Support customer trust: contribute to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews, and communicate the shared responsibility model clearly and credibly.
* Present security posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership, including the executive team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* 10+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or security operations, with 3+ years managing technical security teams.
* Deep hands-on experience securing AWS, GCP, and/or Azure and Kubernetes environments at scale.
* Strong IAM background: SSO/federation, privileged access management, workload identity, and Zero Trust architecture.
* Proven experience running or building detection and response capabilities, including incident command for significant events.
* Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native detection tooling, and with writing or reviewing detection logic.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

### **Preferred**

* Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
* Experience with policy-as-code (OPA/Rego), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD security.
* Experience with Enterprise Security.
* Familiarity with securing AI-enabled products and the supply chain around them.
* Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GCP/AWS security specialty, GIAC) are a plus, not a requirement.

*Harness is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive hiring process.*

  

### **What you will have at Harness**

* Experience building a transformative product
* End-to-end ownership of your projects
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefit
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. **A Day in the Life**
=====================

At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies, and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. As a Senior Compliance Specialist, you will serve as a strategic compliance business partner responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and oversight of an effective compliance program that promotes ethical business conduct and mitigates compliance risks across commercial operations.

  

You will provide expert compliance guidance to business leaders and employees, support risk assessments and monitoring activities, oversee channel partner compliance programs, and help ensure adherence to company policies, industry codes, and applicable laws and regulations. The role requires the ability to influence stakeholders, balance business objectives with compliance requirements, and drive a strong culture of integrity throughout the organization.

  

This is an individual-contributor role and the position will be in Mumbai in India and has responsibility mainly for India Subcontinent (subject to changes). The position will report directly to the India Subcontinent Compliance Officer.

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

  

**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and functional stakeholders on compliance and data privacy matters. Understand business strategies, operating models, commercial priorities, and emerging initiatives to provide timely and practical compliance guidance.
* Advise on Global Business Conduct Standards/Compliance Policy such as HCP/HCO interactions, sponsorships, educational grants, consulting arrangements, and promotional activities, in adherence with applicable laws, codes, regulations, and company policies.
* Clearly document compliance advice, risk assessments, approvals, exceptions, and agreed mitigation actions.
* Monitor regulatory and industry developments and support the implementation of relevant changes in policies, processes, systems, training, and business practices.
* Support the integration of privacy principles into business processes, digital initiatives, customer programs, vendor arrangements, and projects involving personal or sensitive data.
Promote privacy-by-design principles by encouraging teams to consider data minimization, purpose limitation, appropriate access, retention, security, transparency, consent, and individual rights at the beginning of an initiative.  

**Data Analytics and Risk Insights**

* Develop dashboards, metrics, and reports for management and compliance leadership to analyse trends.
* Translate analytical findings into clear risk insights, recommendations, and action plans for business and compliance stakeholders, for continuous improvement of the compliance program.
* Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for process and control enhancements.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators supporting continuous improvement.
Track remediation activities and evaluate whether implemented actions have appropriately addressed identified risks.  

  

**Compliance Monitoring and Process Reviews**

* Support in developing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring plans aligned with country, business, and program priorities.
